opening.argument: The presentation leads with a free-coin promise and extraordinary returns, advertising “GET Free 1000 BNB” and claiming that 0.3 BNB produced over 10.7 BNB in minutes. It then gives viewers an operational path: obtain linked contract code, connect a MetaMask wallet, deploy and transact with the contract, and send BNB to it. The promised outcome is tied to the size of the deposit, stating that “The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment.” When the expected result does not appear, the instructions encourage another deposit rather than treating the failure as disqualifying. The reported gains are presented as support for following this process, while the required steps expose viewers to sending funds into the deployed contract.
